-Description: Work around a PKCS#11-engine load_privkey() segfault on OpenSSL 3.0.12-3.0.13
- Affected OpenSSL versions: 3.0.12-3.0.13, 3.1.4-3.1.5, 3.2.0-3.2.1. A regression
- in these versions wipes pkey->pmeth_engine after ENGINE_load_private_key, causing
- a NULL dereference in RSA_sign (root cause openssl/openssl#23063; regression
- 2b74e75, fixed in 39ea783). Reroute signing through PKEY_CRYPTO for the affected
- versions, avoiding the broken RSA_get_ex_data path.
- .
- 0.4.12 has no prior OpenSSL-version gate, so this introduces the workaround in the
- form released in libp11 0.4.13, assembled from these upstream changes:
-   - c3f2267 (PR #545): introduce the PKEY_CRYPTO version check (3.2.0/3.2.1)
-   - 1b4e3b6 (PR #549): guard it with #if OPENSSL_VERSION_NUMBER >= 0x30000000L
-   - 86c0404 (PR #554): extend the check to 3.0.12-3.0.13 and 3.1.4-3.1.5
-   - ccf3c77: convert the checks to ranges and add error handling
-Author: Guruprasad Lakshmi Narayanan <guruprasad.ln@canonical.com>
-Origin: backport, https://github.com/OpenSC/libp11/commit/ccf3c7739be2263b2415244104e734dd944246ea
-Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/libp11/+bug/2158304
-Applied-Upstream: 0.4.13, https://github.com/OpenSC/libp11/commit/ccf3c7739be2263b2415244104e734dd944246ea
-Last-Update: 2026-07-07

-@@ -186,6 +186,21 @@
